subject: Vectra.ai embeddings p99 regression after catalog sync — escalation & exec notice
messages:
From: Maya Roth <maya@vectra.ai>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, support@vectra.ai
Cc: Arjun Patel <arjun@vectra.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Embeddings p99 up ~5x after catalog sync - urgent

Hi team,

We saw a sudden jump in p95/p99 latency for the embeddings endpoint right after the model catalog sync finished at 08:55 PT. p99 moved from ~420ms to ~2.3s and error rate briefly spiked to 1.8%. This is impacting our semantic search pipeline (batching job) — queries are timing out.

Attached: dashboard snapshot and a brief trace we pulled from our side. Can you confirm if any model variants were flipped and whether there was a rollout around 08:50–09:00 PT? Our SLO window is 99th <= 500ms for this workload.

Severity: high — request an ETA and whether a rollback is possible.

Thanks,
Maya
Maya Roth
Head of ML Ops, Vectra.ai
--
attachments: dashboard_snapshot_20261102.png (image/png), local_trace_excerpt.txt (text)

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Embeddings p99 up ~5x after catalog sync - urgent

Ben / Neha — FYI Vectra is reporting a big p99 regression immediately after today's catalog sync. Can you triage? Priorities:
- Confirm whether the catalog push included a new embedding model variant or quantization profile.
- Check the serving runtime for any kernel fallback/soft-failure on the embedding model (sequence lengths ~384).
- If a regression is confirmed, prepare a canary rollback to the previous catalog snapshot and estimate impact.

Cc'ing Laura for visibility (exec line). Please update this thread with findings and ETA on rollback.

-Vivek

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Embeddings p99 up ~5x after catalog sync - urgent

On Mon, Nov 2, 2026 at 9:20 AM vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai wrote:
> Ben / Neha — FYI Vectra is reporting a big p99 regression immediately after today's catalog sync. Can you triage?

Quick update from infra: the catalog sync at 08:52 deployed model_catalog snapshot v2026-11-02-embed-v3 which enabled a new fused-kernel path + int8 quantized weights for the public 'embed-s' family. We're seeing a subset of hosts (roughly 12%) compile fallback to a slower generic kernel (non-fused) for sequences >=256, which explains the p99 tail increase. Repro steps in our CI show a similar pattern for longer sequences.

Log excerpt (trimmed):
[2026-11-02T08:53:12Z] MODEL_LOAD: embed-s v3 -> quantized int8
[2026-11-02T08:53:16Z] KERNEL_SELECT: fused_attention_xla -> compiled_ok
[2026-11-02T08:53:18Z] KERNEL_FALLBACK: fused_attention_xla -> generic_attention (reason: missing kernel symbol on host /cuda61)
[2026-11-02T08:58:03Z] REQUEST_LATENCY: qid=... p99=2300ms

Recommended immediate action: rollback catalog to v2026-11-01-embed-v2 for the affected host pool, and pin Vectra's traffic to stable pool until we confirm full kernel availability across all hosts. I'll prepare a rollback plan — ETA 45m for staged rollback and monitoring.

Attaching a full trace we pulled from one affected host: embed_trace_20261102.txt

-ben

From: Arjun Patel <arjun@vectra.ai>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: Maya Roth <maya@vectra.ai>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Embeddings p99 up ~5x after catalog sync - urgent

Thanks for the quick response.
This is hitting our nightly indexing pipeline — retries are burning through our quota. We need an ETA and a mitigation path (rollback or traffic-split). Please prioritize; if you need to escalate to execs for credits/priority capacity we'll involve our procurement.

Maya — I'm getting exec-level pressure here; appreciate any speed-up.

-Arjun

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, Maya Roth <maya@vectra.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Exec sync & rollback plan — Vectra embeddings latency

Marissa / Laura — escalating for visibility. Summary: catalog v2026-11-02-embed-v3 caused partial kernel fallback on ~12% of hosts for long-sequence embeds, spiking p99 to ~2.3s for Vectra's workload. Ben proposes staged rollback to v2026-11-01-embed-v2 pinned to Vectra's pool; ETA ~45 minutes to run and validate.

Immediate asks: 
- Approve staged rollback (roll back 20% of Vectra traffic in 10m, 100% in 45m if metrics recover).
- Authorize brief SLA exception window and credits discussion if needed.

Tactical notes for engineering: 
- Warm KV cache on rollback hosts with a small synthetic burst (5k short queries) to reduce cold-cache tail.
- Do not restart embedding pods during rollback to avoid cold-starts; prefer config switch at router level.

I'll host a 15-minute exec sync at 11:40 PT to confirm rollback; join link: https://meet.redwood.example/execs/rollout-7182

-Vivek

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, Maya Roth <maya@vectra.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec sync & rollback plan — Vectra embeddings latency

Rollback started at 11:42 PT against Vectra's pool (staged: 20% -> 100%). Monitoring shows p99 dropping back toward baseline within first validation window: current p99=480ms, p95=210ms, error rate=0.2%. Continuing to monitor for 60 minutes; will create postmortem and RCA doc (link to be shared).

Immediate follow-ups:
- RCA will include host-level kernel mismatch root cause and an action to add kernel compatibility pre-check to catalog rollout pipeline.
- Ops to propose credits/compensation cadence if customer requests; flagging to finance.

Attachments: embed_trace_20261102.txt, dashboard_snapshot_20261102.png

-ben
